## Overview

An interactive clinical data dashboard built with R and the **Pharmaverse** ecosystem, enhanced with an **AI assistant** powered by Groq.

The dashboard uses the public CDISC pilot dataset — the reference dataset used in regulatory submissions training worldwide.

## Features

-   📊 **Clinical tables** — Demographics, Adverse Events summaries
-   📈 **Kaplan-Meier survival curves** — interactive visualisation
-   🤖 **AI chat assistant** — ask questions about the data in plain English
-   🔬 Built with `tern`, `rtables`, `survminer`, `Pharmaverse`

## Tech stack

-   `shiny` — interactive web application
-   `tern` / `rtables` — clinical tables (Pharmaverse)
-   `survminer` / `survival` — Kaplan-Meier curves
-   `Groq API` — AI assistant (Llama 3.3 70B)
-   Data : CDISC pilot public dataset
